title: Orthogonality of binary Walsh characters
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $a,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The uniform expectation over $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$ of $(-1)^{x\cdot y}$ times the Walsh character indexed by $a$ is $1$ if $y=a$ and $0$ otherwise.
